thesis: Malicious pool type returns inflated amountOut to drain pool reserves
evidence: Pool type address must have 6 leading zero bytes (AMMModule.sol:109). _safeDecrementUint128 reverts if amountOut > reserve (AMMModule.sol:1437). Balance check at AMMModule.sol:2208 verifies actual ERC20 transfer.

thesis: Malicious transfer handler skips token transfer but core believes funds arrived
evidence: Core checks balanceInBefore + swapCache.amountIn != balanceInAfter at AMMModule.sol:2208. Non-transferring handler caught by balance verification.

evidence: computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow (SqrtPriceCalculator.sol:51-53). validateHandlerOrder missing zero check vs _validatePricingBounds which has it (line 847). But CLOB fills go through AMM swap path which has the check. Low severity only (CP-003). Confirmed via Halmos symbolic execution.

thesis: Storage slot collision across diamond facets corrupts pool accounting
evidence: Slither storage layout confirms all 4 modules have 0 local slots. All state via LBAMMStorage.appStorage() at slot 0x9A1D. No collision possible.
